+@pytest.mark.parametrize("chain_type", ["cause", "context"])
+def test_application_exception_chain_is_preserved(
+    test_client_factory: TestClientFactory,
+    chain_type: str,
+) -> None:
+    original_exc = ValueError("original")
+
+    async def error_endpoint(_: Request) -> None:
+        if chain_type == "cause":
+            raise RuntimeError("application") from original_exc
+
+        try:
+            raise original_exc
+        except ValueError:
+            raise RuntimeError("application")
+
+    async def passthrough(request: Request, call_next: RequestResponseEndpoint) -> Response:
+        return await call_next(request)
+
+    app = Starlette(
+        middleware=[Middleware(BaseHTTPMiddleware, dispatch=passthrough)],
+        routes=[Route("/", error_endpoint)],
+    )
+
+    client = test_client_factory(app)
+    with pytest.raises(RuntimeError, match="application") as exc_info:
+        client.get("/")
+
+    visible_context = exc_info.value.__cause__ or exc_info.value.__context__
+    assert visible_context is original_exc
+
